About Our Brand and Products

HoloScope creates specialized inspection tools for trading card and sports card collectors. Our FlawFinder Mini and FlawFinder Pro are positioned as the first handheld inspection cameras designed specifically for examining TCG and sports cards before buying, selling, or submitting them for grading.

What Makes Us Different

Unlike traditional magnifiers, microscopes, or stationary inspection equipment, FlawFinder cameras are portable, easy to use, and built around the needs of card collectors. They help users examine surfaces, corners, edges, print lines, scratches, whitening, and other visible defects with greater clarity.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn commissions on qualifying purchases generated through their unique referral links or approved coupon codes. The more collectors, dealers, card shops, breakers, and grading enthusiasts you introduce to HoloScope, the greater your earning opportunity.

How to Promote Us

Affiliates can promote HoloScope through product demonstrations, card inspection videos, grading-preparation content, social-media posts, live streams, card-show coverage, blogs, email campaigns, collector communities, and direct recommendations. Showing the FlawFinder in use is one of the strongest ways to demonstrate its value.

Other Information

Approved affiliates may receive access to product images, logos, promotional materials, referral links, and coupon codes. Commissions are reviewed and paid quarterly, subject to order validation, refunds, chargebacks, and compliance with the HoloScope Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions.
payout_period: Affiliate commissions are reviewed and processed quarterly. Approved earnings from each calendar quarter are issued after the quarter closes, subject to validation for refunds, chargebacks, fraud, and compliance with all HoloScope Affiliate Program terms.

HOLOSCOPE AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Effective Date: June 24, 2026
Last Updated: June 24, 2026

These HoloScope Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions (“Agreement”) govern participation in the HoloScope Affiliate Program (“Program”).

The Program is operated by Spoxy, LLC, doing business as HoloScope (“HoloScope,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). The Program may be administered through UpPromote, Shopify, or another affiliate-management service provider.

By submitting an application, creating an affiliate account, accepting these terms electronically, or otherwise participating in the Program, you agree to be bound by this Agreement.

If you do not agree to every provision of this Agreement, you may not register for or participate in the Program.

1. Eligibility

To participate in the Program, you must:

  1. Be at least 18 years old.
  2. Be legally capable of entering into a binding agreement.
  3. Provide accurate, current, and complete registration information.
  4. Maintain accurate contact, payment, tax, and promotional-channel information.
  5. Comply with this Agreement and all applicable laws, regulations, advertising requirements, and platform policies.
  6. Operate all websites, social-media accounts, email lists, advertising accounts, and other promotional channels lawfully.

Participation is void where prohibited by law.

2. Application Approval

Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance into the Program.

HoloScope may approve or reject any application in its sole discretion. HoloScope is not required to provide a reason for rejecting an application.

We may reject, suspend, or terminate applications or accounts associated with:

  • Incomplete, inaccurate, or misleading information.
  • Unlawful, deceptive, offensive, sexually explicit, hateful, violent, or infringing content.
  • Unauthorized coupon, discount, loyalty, cashback, browser-extension, or paid-advertising activities.
  • Fraudulent or suspicious conduct.
  • Activities that create legal, regulatory, customer-service, or reputational risk for HoloScope.
  • Prior violations of HoloScope policies or agreements.

3. Program Settings

The following commercial terms will be displayed in the affiliate dashboard, registration page, affiliate guide, or written communications from HoloScope:

  • Commission rate.
  • Eligible products and collections.
  • Cookie or attribution period.
  • Payment schedule.
  • Minimum payment threshold.
  • Available payment methods.
  • Product-specific or campaign-specific rules.
  • Network or sub-affiliate commission settings, when applicable.

HoloScope may change these commercial terms prospectively.

If a commercial setting displayed in the affiliate dashboard conflicts with this Agreement, the dashboard setting will govern that specific commercial issue. This Agreement governs all legal, compliance, intellectual-property, privacy, and affiliate-conduct requirements.

4. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Approved affiliates may receive:

  • A unique affiliate referral link.
  • A personalized coupon code.
  • Access to approved banners, photographs, videos, logos, product descriptions, or other promotional materials.

Affiliate links and coupon codes may only be used by the affiliate to whom they are assigned.

Affiliates may not:

  1. Transfer, sell, sublicense, or assign an affiliate link or coupon code.
  2. Advertise a coupon code that has not been assigned or approved for their use.
  3. Promote expired, unauthorized, fabricated, altered, or misleading discounts.
  4. Represent that a coupon provides a greater discount than it actually provides.
  5. Submit coupon codes to coupon, discount, loyalty, cashback, or deal websites without prior written approval.
  6. Use another affiliate’s coupon code or referral link.
  7. Use technology that automatically applies a coupon or inserts an affiliate identifier without the customer knowingly taking the relevant action.
  8. Alter affiliate links in a manner that interferes with referral tracking.

Use of both an affiliate link and a coupon code for the same order does not create a double commission.

5. Referral Tracking and Attribution

Referral activity may be tracked through UpPromote, Shopify, cookies, coupon codes, affiliate links, and related technologies.

A referral is credited only when:

  1. The customer uses an eligible affiliate link or authorized coupon code.
  2. The referral is successfully recorded by the Program’s tracking system.
  3. The customer completes a Qualifying Purchase.
  4. The order complies with this Agreement and current Program settings.

When a customer interacts with links belonging to multiple affiliates, the last eligible referral interaction recorded by the Program will ordinarily receive attribution, subject to coupon-code attribution rules and the Program settings in effect at the time of purchase.

HoloScope is not responsible for tracking failures caused by:

  • Disabled, rejected, blocked, or deleted cookies.
  • Cleared browser data.
  • Privacy or tracking-prevention software.
  • Ad blockers.
  • Incorrectly formatted, shortened, or altered links.
  • Customer use of another browser or device.
  • Network interruptions.
  • Third-party platform restrictions.
  • Software or service-provider errors outside HoloScope’s reasonable control.

Manual commission adjustments are not guaranteed. HoloScope’s tracking records will control unless a verified system error is established.

6. Qualifying Purchases

A “Qualifying Purchase” is a completed purchase from HoloScope.shop that:

  1. Is properly attributed to an approved affiliate.
  2. Is paid in full.
  3. Has not been cancelled, refunded, returned, disputed, or charged back.
  4. Is not fraudulent or suspicious.
  5. Does not violate this Agreement.
  6. Is not excluded by the Program settings.

Unless otherwise stated in the affiliate dashboard, commissions are calculated using the eligible product subtotal after discounts.

Commissions are not calculated on:

  • Taxes.
  • Shipping or delivery charges.
  • Duties, customs charges, or import fees.
  • Gift-card purchases.
  • Payment-processing fees.
  • Refunded, returned, cancelled, or charged-back amounts.
  • Fraudulent or suspicious transactions.
  • Test transactions.
  • Duplicate orders.
  • Unauthorized promotional activity.
  • Prohibited self-referrals.
  • Products or collections identified as noncommissionable.

A partial refund may result in a proportional commission reduction or reversal.

7. Self-Referrals and Related-Party Purchases

Affiliates may not earn commissions on purchases made:

  • By the affiliate.
  • Using the affiliate’s own payment method.
  • For the affiliate’s personal benefit.
  • By a member of the affiliate’s household.
  • By a business controlled by the affiliate.
  • Through coordinated transactions designed primarily to generate a commission.
  • Through another account created or controlled by the affiliate.

HoloScope may approve a specific related-party transaction in writing. No exception applies unless approval is obtained before the purchase is completed.

8. Commission Review

All commissions remain pending until reviewed and approved.

HoloScope may investigate, delay, reject, reverse, offset, or withhold a commission when necessary to review:

  • Fraud or suspected fraud.
  • Refunds, returns, cancellations, or chargebacks.
  • Duplicate attribution.
  • Tracking errors.
  • Payment disputes.
  • Unauthorized advertising.
  • Self-referrals.
  • Coupon misuse.
  • Artificial traffic.
  • Violations of this Agreement.
  • Suspected manipulation of the Program.

A commission displayed in the affiliate dashboard is an estimate until approved. Dashboard information does not constitute a promise or guarantee of payment.

9. Payments

Approved commissions will be paid according to the payment schedule, payment threshold, and payment method displayed in the affiliate dashboard.

The affiliate is responsible for:

  1. Providing accurate and complete payment information.
  2. Maintaining an active account capable of receiving payment.
  3. Providing requested tax forms, identification, or verification documentation.
  4. Paying payment-provider, transfer, or currency-conversion fees unless HoloScope expressly agrees otherwise.
  5. Reporting and paying all taxes associated with affiliate income.

HoloScope is not responsible for payment delays resulting from:

  • Incorrect payment information.
  • Payment-provider restrictions.
  • Unverified accounts.
  • Missing tax documentation.
  • Banking delays.
  • Circumstances outside HoloScope’s reasonable control.

HoloScope may offset amounts owed by an affiliate against commissions otherwise payable to that affiliate.

10. Required Affiliate Disclosures

Affiliates must clearly and conspicuously disclose their financial relationship with HoloScope whenever promoting HoloScope, the FlawFinder Mini, the FlawFinder Pro, or any other HoloScope product.

The disclosure must:

  1. Appear close to the endorsement, recommendation, affiliate link, or coupon code.
  2. Be easy for an ordinary consumer to notice and understand.
  3. Be presented before or at the time the consumer encounters the affiliate link.
  4. Be included in every applicable post, article, email, advertisement, story, video, live stream, podcast, or other promotion.
  5. Be audible when an endorsement is spoken in video or audio content.
  6. Be visible on screen when an endorsement appears in video content.
  7. Not be hidden among hashtags, below a “more” link, at the end of a long description, or only on a profile page.

Acceptable examples include:

  • “I may earn a commission if you purchase through this link.”
  • “Paid affiliate link.”
  • “HoloScope affiliate partner. I receive a commission from qualifying purchases.”
  • “Ad.”
  • “Sponsored.”

Terms such as “affiliate link,” “ambassador,” “partner,” “commissionable link,” “collab,” or “thanks to HoloScope” may not adequately explain the financial relationship when used without additional disclosure.

Affiliates must comply with Federal Trade Commission endorsement requirements and all other advertising-disclosure requirements applicable to their audience.

11. Truthful Product Claims

All affiliate statements must be truthful, accurate, supportable, and consistent with current official HoloScope product information.

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false, misleading, exaggerated, or unsupported claims.
  • Guarantee card grades, grading outcomes, gem rates, financial returns, resale values, or profits.
  • State or imply that a HoloScope product detects every defect, alteration, counterfeit card, or grading issue.
  • Represent personal opinions or experiences as guaranteed or universal results.
  • Create or publish fabricated testimonials, reviews, demonstrations, or comparisons.
  • Make statements that contradict HoloScope specifications, instructions, warranties, or safety information.
  • Claim an official relationship with a grading company, card manufacturer, marketplace, or trademark owner unless that relationship has been documented and approved.
  • Use another person’s review, photograph, grading report, card image, or content without permission.
  • Describe HoloScope products as medical, scientific, diagnostic, or laboratory equipment unless expressly authorized by HoloScope.

Affiliates must clearly distinguish personal opinions from verified product specifications.

12. Product Demonstrations and Reviews

Affiliates who demonstrate or review HoloScope products must:

  1. Present the product accurately.
  2. Disclose whether the product was provided free of charge or at a discount.
  3. Disclose whether compensation was received.
  4. Describe their genuine experience and opinion.
  5. Avoid editing footage or images in a manner that creates a materially misleading impression.
  6. Avoid guaranteeing that another customer will experience the same result.
  7. Follow HoloScope product instructions and safety guidance.

Affiliates may provide honest positive or negative opinions. HoloScope does not require an affiliate to provide a positive review.

13. Prohibited Promotional Practices

Affiliates may not engage in:

  1. Spam or unlawful unsolicited communications.
  2. Cookie stuffing.
  3. Forced clicks.
  4. Hidden frames.
  5. Automatic redirects.
  6. Unauthorized browser extensions.
  7. Adware, spyware, malware, or deceptive software.
  8. Fake traffic, automated clicks, bots, artificial orders, or commission manipulation.
  9. Misleading domains, advertisements, landing pages, profiles, or social-media accounts.
  10. Impersonation of HoloScope, Spoxy, LLC, HoloScope employees, customer support, or official HoloScope accounts.
  11. Trademark infringement or confusingly similar branding.
  12. False scarcity statements or fabricated countdown timers.
  13. Unauthorized pricing or discount claims.
  14. Incentivized clicks or purchases unless expressly approved.
  15. Promotion through unlawful, defamatory, hateful, violent, sexually explicit, or infringing content.
  16. Promotion where the product or promotion is unlawful.
  17. Encouraging customers to cancel and reorder purchases to create or redirect commission.
  18. Interfering with another affiliate’s links, advertisements, coupons, tracking, or attribution.
  19. Creating fake reviews or testimonials.
  20. Offering unauthorized rebates, refunds, gifts, or compensation to customers.
  21. Using HoloScope customer information for unrelated purposes.

  • Represent themselves as HoloScope customer support.
  • Outrank or directly compete with HoloScope’s branded paid-search campaigns.
  • Use HoloScope trademarks in paid social-media advertising without approval.

Approved paid advertising must comply with all written instructions from HoloScope and the policies of the applicable advertising platform.

Affiliates may not represent that an email, text message, or direct message was sent by HoloScope unless HoloScope expressly authorized the communication.

Network commissions remain subject to the same approval, refund, fraud, payment, and compliance requirements as direct commissions.
